mcq_drop.why: vague, oddly worded generic CubeSat item

patterns: APPSC repeats 'which is not a student satellite' with GSAT-1 as the odd one out (asked twice).
Launcher-satellite pairs asked directly (RISAT-1 on PSLV-C19); stems often quote a long technical description then ask one fact.
Recent APPSC G1 uses 3-statement items on new student satellites (WESAT: LBS Institute, PSLV-C58 POEM-3, solar UV not groundwater).
Other PSCs ask EDUSAT date (20 Sep 2004), PSLV-C37 104 satellites, RISAT-2/ANUSAT on PSLV-C12.
App adds defence-space programme detail (SBS-3 cost shares, DSA/DSRO, GSAT-7 series nicknames) that PYQs have not reached yet.
